status: Unpublished release candidate. Not on npm, under this or any other name. Install from the versioned archive at https://zodiacs.org/examples/, whose SHA-256 is published beside it.

bundled.note: Inlined into server.mjs by esbuild because neither is published: the engine is an unpublished candidate, and the comparison is TypeScript in the site repository. Bundling is what keeps one copy of the comparison rules rather than two.

comparison.note: The same module the browser tool at https://zodiacs.org/developers/compare/ runs.

protocol.note: Revisions observed to negotiate against this server on the wire, one probe each. The official SDK client offers 2025-11-25.

schemas.note: Zodiacs-owned draft vocabulary, not an industry interoperability standard.

changedSince: rc.1 through rc.10 remain unchanged as separate archives. This candidate bundles engine 0.1.1-rc.14 in place of rc.10. Its three tools, their arguments and their answers are rc.10's apart from the engine version they report: the natal positions, angles, houses, aspects and records rc.14 computes for the dates this adapter accepts are rc.10's. The engine adds configurable aspects, declinations and parallels (rc.11), secondary progressions (rc.12) and exact configured-aspect decisions (rc.13 and rc.14); this adapter's tools expose none of them, and it still does not expose chartPoints. The engine now refuses instants outside its ephemeris span, years 1 to 3998, which this adapter's 1800-01-01 to 2199-12-31 never reaches. Its Node requirement, 20.19.0 or a later 20.x, or 22.7.0 or later, is for importing the package unbundled; server.mjs carries the engine bundled, and this adapter still requires Node 22 or later. The receipt conventions remain rc.8's. A record naming another engine version is not reproduced on this engine; its differences remain hypotheses.
